purpose: Map and rebuild NiDX9Renderer's two direct draw entries, vtable 0x00A88EA4 slots 90 (0x007694F0) and 91 (0x00769700), as units for single-pass stereo (the contract in src/engine/render/StereoDrawDirect.h; the sibling rebuilds NiDX9Renderer_DrawPrimitive{Logic,}.h and NiDX9Renderer_DrawSkinnedPrimitive{Logic,}.h in src/engine/render/ and their maps re/functions/0x007672F0.md, 0x00767520.md show the shape: reuse their draw-loop logic where the instructions are the same, say where they differ). Both draw one geometry with the pipeline the caller set up: gate on renderer byte +0x6F0, the data's vertex count through the data's vtable slot +0x50, skinned-or-whole through 0x00768890(geometry, 0), the RTTI cast of geometry+0xBC to NiD3DShaderInterface through 0x00560920 (read whether a null result is tested), the shader's slot +0x48, the render state's sub-object slot 1, then the device draws (whole: DrawPrimitive when the record has no index buffer, else DrawIndexedPrimitive per array entry; skinned: per partition with the default-shader bone gate against renderer+0x6D8 and the 0x0060D0A0 message, DrawIndexedPrimitive per array entry), then data+0x2E &= 0xF000; slot 91 also copies the geometry's world bound +0x20..+0x2C into renderer +0x658..+0x664. Map each at instruction level (the exports are in re/export/draw-entries/), then rebuild each as a unit over ports, 1:1 in its port-call sequence and arguments with EyePlan{1} (the emulator gate: cases per branch, the original's traced calls as expectations) PLUS the one documented deviation of StereoDrawDirect.h: with EyePlan{2} the device draw(s) run a second time after eyeSwitch.Switch(1) and before eyeSwitch.Switch(0), right after the first eye's draw(s) (per partition for the skinned arm), nothing else moving. The logic is 64-bit clean (handles as std::uint32_t); the engine shapes go into the <Name>.h header with static_asserts. Tests: every mapped branch, the two-eye flow, the refusal paths (gate set, zero vertices, the bone gate).
